analysis_notes.gap_analysis_narrative: All four nodes in the dataset (מחשבות קדושות, חיות טהורות, מחשבות רעות, חיות טמאות) are fully assigned to packages. No orphaned nodes exist. The Torah source text was read in full. The only bechina language present is the two statements already captured: 'מַחֲשָׁבוֹת קְדוֹשׁוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת חַיּוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת' and 'מַחֲשָׁבוֹת רָעוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת חַיּוֹת טְמֵאוֹת'. The third bechina-like phrase 'הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת הֵם בָּאִים מִבְּחִינַת הַחַיּוֹת' describes the general parent category (thoughts come from the aspect of animals, as a whole), not a new specific bechina pair — it is the umbrella statement from which the two specific pairs are derived. Other concepts mentioned in the Torah (תַּעֲנוּג, נִצָּחוֹן, שֵׁב וְאַל תַּעֲשֶׂה, תּוֹרָה, עֲבוֹדָה, מַשָּׂא וּמַתָּן) are all introduced with causal (eitza) language, not bechina language, and therefore do not belong in any package.
